title: Winter as a Health System
dek: At -40°C, pipes freeze, roads close, ambulances slow down, and emergency rooms fill. Cold is not background. It is infrastructure.
author: Paul Hobson

title: Who Pays for Sprawl
dek: Every new suburb generates development fees and property taxes. It also creates kilometres of pipe, road, and wire that someone will have to maintain forever. The math rarely adds up.
author: Paul Hobson

title: The Measurement State

author: Paul Hobson

title: The Distance to Care
dek: Alberta has among the worst physician-to-population ratios in Canada. For most residents that is a statistic. For a growing number it is a geography — measured in hours and kilometres.
author: Paul Hobson

title: Fire Country

author: Paul Hobson

title: The Insurance Geography
dek: Insurance does not prevent disasters. It prices the geography of risk and decides who can afford to live where. In Alberta, that pricing is changing.
author: Paul Hobson

title: Watching Water

title: Capital Country
